title: Formally Verified Biophysical Invariants, Multi-Language Differential Oracles, and Pre-Registered Monte Carlo Simulation of the Human Synaptic Bouton
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 repository CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 (zero Mathlib, zero Classical.choice, 24 theorems + 27 non-vacuity witnesses + 6 sanity checks; Solution checked against Challenge by lake comparator --paranoid and all default targets by lake check --paranoid on 6 kernels in CI run 45747272478, interactive /blueprint/ DAG)

core_result: Proves 24 elementary algebraic and discrete-dynamical biophysical invariants with explicit positive-domain guarantees across 6 synaptic domains in pure Lean 4.35.0 (incl. Hill n=4 vs. n=1 sigmoidal crossover T06, fixed-point Tsodyks-Markram STP bounds T07, monotonicity of D/(D+m*e) in an abstract natural e, the form used for Jahr-Stevens Mg2+ unblock (T11; voltage dependence not formalised), structural-induction multi-step vesicle conservation T13, and a discrete ATP depletion upper bound T15 (the mean-rate integer store is 0 for every t >= floor(a0/D)+1, which is 3 s for the H3 constants; the simulated runs are jittered); 27 non-vacuity witnesses + 6 sanity and sharpness checks in AdversarialChecks.lean; replayed across 6 independent kernels in CI run 45747272478 with live README axiom drift checking & interactive /blueprint/ DAG), validates TypeScript and Rust kernels against a 50-digit NaN/Inf-guarded mpmath oracle over 1,000 random inputs (0 mismatches within 1e-10), kills 6/6 core mutants, resolves 21 DOIs on Crossref (one, xu2016dnaorigami, points to an unrelated paper; titles and authors are not compared; the retraction check does not read Crossref updated-by), compiles with literal 0 LaTeX warnings, seals 47-artifact MANIFEST.sha256 with DigiCert RFC 3161 + OpenTimestamps + SLSA v4 attestations + Croissant 1.0 metadata, achieves 100.0% (79/79) Build Standard v1.1.0, reports that H1 and H2 hold in the simulator (p_Holm=0.0005; properties of chosen parameters, not measurements), and that the registered 40 Hz H3 prediction fails in the fixed-parameter simulator, alongside exploratory 20 Hz H3b.
verification_boundary: All 24 lemmas, 27 witness theorems and 6 sanity checks are kernel-checked in Lean 4.35.0 (zero sorry in proof modules; Challenge.lean holds 24 sorry statement stubs for the comparator; zero Classical.choice, zero _native) across 6 independent kernels in CI; RK4 Hodgkin-Huxley ODE and ChaCha8Rng Monte Carlo trajectories are explicitly labeled numerical_approximation; pre-registered H3 (40 Hz) is reported as refuted and H3b (20 Hz) as post-hoc exploratory. Software Heritage v1.3.0 snapshot awaits browser PoW (prior v1.2.0 SWHID preserved).
